dz: 以西汉大臣霍光为首的一批官员，向摄政的上官皇太后呈递弹劾新皇帝刘贺的奏章。
de: A group of officials, led by the Western Han minister Huo Guang, present articles of impeachment against the new emperor, Liu He, to the imperial regent, Empress Dowager Shangguan.
